query:
with proches as (
            select id from plis
            where etat = 'a_traiter'
              and mj_alerte_le is null
              and destinataire_genre is distinct from 'gazette'
              and date_proposee <= now() + make_interval(mins => $1)
            for update skip locked
        )
        update plis p set mj_alerte_le = now()
        from proches x
        where p.id = x.id
        returning p.id
